SINLESS.Name: Name
SINLESS.TargetNumberHint: Set by the run difficulty and operational heat in the world settings.

Lifestyle.title: Lifestyle
Lifestyle.payHint: Pay this sector turn's lifestyle: a pre-purchased month first, otherwise the monthly cost in zuzus (p.46).
Lifestyle.payConfirm: Pay one sector turn of lifestyle now? (Brand members pay automatically when the brand ends its sector turn.)
Lifestyle.buyHint: Pre-purchase months of the current lifestyle.
Lifestyle.bought: Bought {n} month(s) of {lifestyle} lifestyle for {cost}ㄓ ({months} prepaid).
Lifestyle.noPermission: Lifestyle not paid: you do not own this character.

paid.unpaid: {lifestyle}: cannot pay {cost}ㄓ (only {zuzu}ㄓ). Choose a cheaper lifestyle; squatting is free.

Condition.penaltyHint: Wounds (−1 per 3 boxes on each track), encumbrance and situational penalty.

difficulty.name: Run difficulty
difficulty.hint: Default target number for player tests during the current operation.

heat.name: Operational heat
heat.hint: Two stars: +1 bonus die on player tests. Three stars: player target number −1.

baseConditionBoxes.name: Base condition boxes
baseConditionBoxes.hint: 6 is the default. 9 or 12 for a heroic game, 3 for a brutal one.

woundPenalties.name: Wound penalties
woundPenalties.hint: Apply −1 die for every 3 boxes marked on a condition track.

refreshPoolsOnRound.name: Refresh pools each round
refreshPoolsOnRound.hint: Automatically refresh dice pools of all combatants when a new combat round begins.

intrusion.name: Intrusion difficulty
intrusion.hint: Site security for decking tests: secure −1, red site −2, black site −4 penalty dice (p.129).

alert.name: Alert level
alert.hint: Current alert level of the operation. Decking actions raise it (p.130).

Notify.noKismet: No dice left in the Kismet pool.
Notify.noSectorActions: No sector actions left this turn.
Notify.tooManyTraits: More traits than the brand's market cap allows.
Notify.noMember: The brand has no member you control to make this test.
Notify.noDefender: Select a token you control to defend.
Notify.noDeck: Equip a cyberdeck to make decking tests.
Notify.noNan: This software needs control of a network access node.
Notify.noHackingProgram: Mark one software item as the base hacking program.
Notify.vehicleNoDefense: This vehicle cannot make that defense (dodging needs a hot-seated rigger).
Notify.noController: Assign a rigger to this vehicle first.
Notify.notController: You do not control this vehicle's rigger.

Test.impossible: The test is impossible: no dice remain after penalties, or the pool is empty.
Test.preview: Limit {limit} / pool left {available} → pool {pool} + bonus {bonus} + Kismet {kismet} = {total} dice
Test.gearHint: Accuracy and other gear features that raise the limit.
Test.penaltyHint: Penalties remove bonus dice first, then lower the limit.
Test.poolDiceHint: Leave empty to draw the maximum allowed.

penalty.label: Situational penalty
penalty.hint: Extra penalty dice applied to all tests (lighting, drugs, etc.).

charismaPool.label: ¼ Charisma to
charismaPool.hint: One pool receives one quarter of Charisma, chosen at character creation.

defenses.label: Fixed defense dice
defenses.hint: Bestiary dice for this defense (p.195): rolled every time, no pool is spent. Leave empty to defend from the pool like a player character.

entity.label: Network entity (ICE / daemon)
entity.hint: Software that only exists in AR: the stun track is its cohesion track (p.133).

alertAura.label: Alert per grid action
alertAura.hint: Sensor daemon: grid actions in its range raise the alert by this much more (p.205).

shrinkDice.label: Shrink dice
shrinkDice.hint: RNID: dice rolled as a complex action to shrink a decker's influence field (p.205).

metal.label: Metal / electronics
metal.hint: Reduces Zoetic Potential by 1 while carried.

attackDice.label: Attack dice (NPC)
attackDice.hint: Bestiary attack dice (p.195). An NPC rolls exactly this many dice, with no skill limit or pool. Include firing-mode bonuses (e.g. burst 9). Leave empty to use skill + pool.

damage.label: Damage
damage.hint: Weapons: e.g. ½ Str +2. Spells: e.g. 1+Force (net successes are added).

penetration.label: Penetration / AP
penetration.hint: Firearms: compared with the highest ballistic layer (higher armor → stun). Melee: armor piercing ignores that much impact armor.

force.label: Force
force.hint: Spells: force learned (max castable). Spirits: the spirit's force.

drain.label: Drain
drain.hint: Drain code, e.g. 3 + (Force/2). Halved force rounds down, minimum 1.

armorType.label: Stopped by
armorType.hint: Automatic: melee, unarmed and thrown use impact armor; other weapons use ballistic armor.

blast.label: Explosive (area)
blast.hint: Successes reduce scatter instead of adding damage and cannot be dodged away.

mcp.label: MCP
mcp.hint: Master Control Persona: MCP dice added to Focus for decking, and the length of the cohesion track.

threads.label: Threads
threads.hint: Software that can be loaded at once.

core.label: Core
core.hint: Extra exploit actions for loaded software.

nerveRig.label: Nerve rig
nerveRig.hint: Without a nerve rig the decker cannot hot-seat: −2 penalty dice on decking tests.

base.label: Base hacking program
base.hint: Always running; used to hack devices and network access nodes. Must be rated at least half the MCP.

alertNote.label: Alert note
alertNote.hint: For variable alert, e.g. “hardening of target”.

reducesAlert.label: Reduces alert (Shadow Protocols)
reducesAlert.hint: While running in the I/O, alert raised by other software drops by this rating.

bonusDice.label: Bonus dice
bonusDice.hint: Free dice per round for vehicle tests while hot-seated.

links.label: Links
links.hint: Vehicles or drones controlled at once.

spiritBag.label: Spirit bag
spiritBag.hint: Each rank lowers the spirit's force for summoning (p.183).

recoilComp.label: Recoil compensation
recoilComp.hint: Recoil capacity added by mods such as a bipod, gyro-mount or gas vent.

digital.label: Digital attack
digital.hint: ICE and AR weapons: the target's hardening reduces the damage instead of armor (pp.130, 205).

digitalAttack.label: Automated attack
digitalAttack.hint: Resolves the attack against targeted tokens (pp.135-137).

competence.label: Competence
competence.hint: One automatic success on every brand action

luxury.label: Luxury
luxury.hint: +1 Media; +1 market cap for service, vice and housing resources

mercenary.label: Mercenary
mercenary.hint: +1 asset available for hire; each asset's upkeep −1

sophistication.label: Sophistication
sophistication.hint: +1 Grid; +2 market cap for resources with the production tag

mediaCampaign.label: Media Campaign
mediaCampaign.effect: Each success: 1 influence on a resource in the sector.

racketeering.label: Racketeering
racketeering.effect: Each success: 1 damage to one resource. Sector heat +1.

covertInfluence.label: Covert Influence
covertInfluence.effect: Each success: 1 influence on one resource, or sector heat −1.

hakAttack.label: HakAttack
hakAttack.effect: Each success: 1 damage, or every 2 successes: 1 influence on a resource.

ensorcellment.label: Ensorcellment
ensorcellment.effect: Each success: shift a resource's damage or influence by 1 either way.

repair.label: Repair
repair.effect: Each success: remove 1 damage by paying 1 market cap / bank.

reinforceGhost.label: Reinforce Ghost Rating
reinforceGhost.effect: Needs a decker with ghost protocol software. Raise a Ghost Rating as the software lists.

demolish.label: Demolish
demolish.effect: Fully damaged resources only. Each success destroys 2 boxes.

itemCracking.label: Item Cracking
itemCracking.effect: Successes equal to the item's hardening re-code it for the brand.

SectorHeatEffect.0: Vice resources −1 market cap, business resources +2.
SectorHeatEffect.2: Brand Media tests and character Subterfuge/Reconnaissance tests −1 die. Vice resources +10% market cap (min 1).
SectorHeatEffect.3: All resources −1 market cap. Asset and operation preparation tests −2 dice. Enforcement arrives 1d6 rounds into combat.
SectorHeatEffect.4: Crackdown: business resources produce nothing. Asset and preparation tests −4 dice. Enforcement present at the start of combat; HTR in 1d6 rounds.

Brand.assetCapacityExceeded: Asset upkeep exceeds market cap: some assets must move on.
Brand.assetHint: Asset tests are rolled by the member with the best matching etiquette.
Brand.membersHint: Drag character actors here to add them to the brand.

base.label: Base
base.hint: Starts at 1; each player may raise one statistic by 1.

marketAdjust.label: Market cap adjustment
marketAdjust.hint: Assets or other effects that change market cap.

SectorTurn.title: Sector turn {turn}
SectorTurn.confirm: Bank the net market cap, reset used actions and start the next sector turn?
SectorTurn.unmet: Unmet upkeep {n}: each unpaid point deals 1d6 damage to a resource.
SectorTurn.crackdown: Crackdown: at the start of the next turn roll 1d6; on 4+ heat drops to three stars.

Damage.title: Damage: {name}
Damage.modifierHint: Situational change, e.g. −1 per 2 m of mist for energy beams.
Damage.physicalFull: Physical track full: one simple action per turn. Brawn test each turn needs {n} successes or fall unconscious and bleed out.
Damage.stunFull: Stun track full: one simple action per turn. Brawn test each turn needs {n} successes or fall unconscious.
Damage.immune: No damage: the weapon cannot penetrate the vehicle's armor.
Damage.immuneNotice: {name} is immune: the weapon cannot penetrate its armor.

Effect.title: Active Effects
Effect.overridden: Set by an Active Effect. Edit or disable the effect to change it.
Effect.keysHint: Use these keys in an effect's changes (other skills, pools and etiquettes follow the same pattern). Effects on items apply while armor is equipped and gear is carried; implant effects always apply.

Creation.title: Character creation
Creation.modeHint: Show the creation panel with priority budgets and rule checks on the Main tab.
Creation.attributeAdjustHint: Heritage change to the attribute points, e.g. −1 for an uplifted dog (p.48).

issue.priorityDuplicate: Each priority can be used only once: {levels}.
issue.heritagePriority: This heritage needs heritage priority {min} or better.
issue.talentPriority: This magical talent needs magic priority {min} or better.
issue.ritualHigh: Rituals: no rank above {max} during creation.

Creation.extraAsset: Charisma 11+: you gain one additional upkeep-free asset.
Creation.finishConfirm: Hide the creation panel? Unspent points and cash are lost. You can turn creation mode back on in the Biography tab.

Grid.rangePenaltyHint: Extending influence beyond 40 m: −2 dice, another −2 every 20 m (p.134).
Grid.resetInfluence: Lose control of the node (reset influence)
Grid.mcpHint: MCP dice add to the Focus pool for decking tests only and refresh each round (p.130).

issue.baseRating: The base hacking program must be rated at least {min} (half the MCP).

Grid.noDeckHint: Create a cyberdeck and software below, then equip the deck.
Grid.deviceHint: Needs successes ≥ twice the target's hardening; successes can accumulate (p.133).

body.label: Body
body.hint: Physical track length and soak dice.

weaponWeight.label: Weapon weight (WW)
weaponWeight.hint: Weight of weapons the drone can mount.

handling.label: Handling
handling.hint: Raises the limit of Drive/Fly tests.

inertia.label: Inertia
inertia.hint: Street vehicles: −1 die per point. Gained by overdrive moves; ramming clears it (pp.143-144).

battleRam.label: Battle Ram
battleRam.hint: Double damage dealt and half damage taken when ramming (p.149).

Vehicle.penaltyHint: −1 die per 3 damage boxes, inertia (vehicles) and situational penalty.
Vehicle.dodgeHint: Only a hot-seated rigger can dodge, using their own Finesse pool (p.144).
Vehicle.controlHint: Manual −4, VCR −2, hot-seat 0. Needs an equipped VCR; hot-seating also needs a nerve rig (p.142).
Vehicle.dropController: Drop a character here to make them the controlling rigger.

Rig.title: Rigging
Rig.overdriveGain: Overdrive: +{n} m on every movement action this round
Rig.ramSelfUnknown: Damage to your vehicle: target Body − successes − inertia
Rig.bonusHint: Free bonus dice for vehicle tests while hot-seated; refresh each round (p.142).
Rig.noVehicles: No vehicles. Drop this character on a drone or vehicle sheet.

Magic.forceHint: Cast at any force up to the force the spell was learned at (p.167).
Magic.lethalHint: Force above your Zoetic Potential: drain is physical and cannot be soaked.
Magic.invokeHint: Invoke the spirit for a service: drain equal to its force (p.183).

summon.uncontrolled: The spirit appears but is not controlled.
summon.failed: The spirit does not appear (needed {needed} successes).

Spec.label: Specialization: {spec}
Spec.hint: Checked: the specialization applies, skill +1. Unchecked: general use, skill −1 (p.41).

Combat.coverHint: Low: something obscures the target. High: the target is taking cover. Total: not visible; penetration must beat the barrier (pp.88, 90).
Combat.rangeHint: From the weapon's range table: positive for bonus dice, negative for penalty dice.
Combat.pointBlankHint: Within 4 m (2″), or the target is caught out (p.90).
Combat.proneHint: Non-adjacent ranged attacks against a prone target (p.87).
Combat.dualWieldHint: Two pistols or SMGs: −1 and no accuracy. Roll each gun separately (p.91).
Combat.aimHint: +accuracy bonus dice per simple action spent aiming, up to two (p.91).
Combat.targetsHint: Each additional target this turn adds a cumulative −1 (p.91).
Combat.recoilHint: Two consecutive simple actions firing give 1 token, a complex action (full auto) 2. At capacity, attacks automatically miss (pp.91-92).
Combat.recoilJammed: Recoil capacity reached: this attack automatically misses. Stabilize first.
Combat.recoilMiss: Recoil capacity was reached: the attack automatically misses.
Combat.stabilizeHint: Free action whenever the character uses an action other than firing: remove all recoil tokens (p.92).

Overload.restricted: Track full: a single simple action per turn; exploit and reflex actions are denied (p.97).
Overload.failPhysical: Unconscious in critical condition: bleeds out in {n} combat round(s).
Overload.failPhysicalNpc: Unconscious in critical condition and bleeding out.
Overload.stabilizeHint: Any success on a Biotech test stabilizes the dying, who wake in 1d6 days (p.97).
Overload.killed: {name} takes more damage than their whole physical track in one attack and is killed (p.97).

Injury.title: Permanent injury test
Injury.hint: After the run: an unmodified Brawn pool test needing as many successes as the overflow damage taken (p.97).
Injury.notNeeded: No overflow damage: no permanent injury test is needed.

result.organ: Organ damage: {attribute} maximum −1, permanently (the statistic is selected randomly).
result.limb: An eye or a limb is rendered inoperable or lost: replace it or regrow it with biotechnology.

Advance.title: Kismet advancement
Advance.boonEarned: The Kismet pool grows: {n} boon(s) to choose.
Advance.noBoon: No boon is available yet (one every 10 Kismet earned).
Advance.undone: {name}: the last advancement entry was undone.
Advance.costHint: New skill 4; raise a skill: its current rank (max 6). Attributes: 3 per point up to 10, 4 from 11 to 15, 5 from 16. Zoetic Potential: twice its current value (pp.214, 238).
Advance.talisman: I have a talisman of power or similar item (needed for Zoetic Potential, p.214)
Advance.needTalisman: Raising the Zoetic Potential needs a talisman of power or similar item.
Advance.boonMajor: Boon #{n}: every second boon may also come from the rare list.
Advance.undoConfirm: Undo the most recent award, purchase or boon and refund its Kismet?

asset.label: Old friend
asset.hint: A new free random asset that needs no upkeep.

item.label: Magic item or experimental tech
item.hint: The Agonarch grants a rare item with your input.

resilience.label: Pool resilience
resilience.hint: Tests with the chosen pool gain a Kismet die that is never exhausted. Can be taken more than once.

Windfall.arcanatech: Gain a prototype Arcanatech (installed in a headquarters, raises a brand stat by 1 permanently).
Windfall.influence: Get 3d6 points of influence on a resource.
Windfall.marketCap: Get 3d6 points of Market Cap added to your brand's bank.
Windfall.cash: Gain 3d6 × 4,000ㄓ in cash or gear of rarity 4 or less.

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.discoveredHint: Identified or suspicious activity seen: heat rises to one star (pp.81, 236).
Operation.responsesHint: Pick 4–7 security responses and give each a threshold (1–50). You are told when the alert reaches them (p.236).
Operation.htr: High-Threat Response team arrives in {n} rounds (2d6).

heatEffect.1: A virtual sensor drone is deployed and security is told to patrol.
heatEffect.2: Roto and dog drones deployed, magically sensitive staff alerted, automated defenses armed. Players get +1 bonus die on all tests.
heatEffect.3: Barricades and checkpoints, more patrols, anthro-drones released. Player target numbers improve by 1.
heatEffect.4: HTR teams are incoming. Every character gets an extra simple action each round.

sectorHeat.0: no sector heat at the end of the operation.
sectorHeat.1: no sector heat at the end of the operation.

Operation.cameraHint: Characters caught on camera (not erased, no recognition immunity) roll 1d6 on the camera table (p.236):
Operation.cachesHint: Each cache: 1d6, a 6 is a relic. Value 3d6 × 1,000 / 10,000 / 100,000 by difficulty; relics ×10 (p.236).

camera.assassination: Targeted for assassination: the Hunted framework starts next fallout.
camera.extraction: Targeted for extraction: the Hunted framework starts next fallout.
camera.mixup: A mix-up: the record has disappeared.

Operation.paydata: Paydata worth {n}ㄓ (sell after the mission at no risk).
Operation.relic: Relic worth {n}ㄓ (takes a sector turn to sell).
Operation.shadowAlert: Shadow test: alert +{n} (0 successes +2, 1 success +1, 2+ none; p.236)

Chase.title: Car chase
Chase.startedText: Escape by completing {legs} legs or losing every pursuer. The path deck is split into {paths} paths.
Chase.legsHint: Collect this many "leg completed" cards to escape (3 / 4 / 5 by difficulty, p.151).
Chase.deckHint: One path card per line. Start a line with + for a "leg completed" card. The deck is shuffled and split between the paths (p.230).
Chase.sampleDeck:
+ Leg completed: highway on-ramp
+ Leg completed: back alleys
+ Leg completed: river bridge
+ Leg completed: industrial zone
Roadblock ahead: Drive test or take 6 damage
A police drone joins the pursuit (close)
Traffic jam: −2 dice on Drive tests this turn
Oil spill: every vehicle loses 1 handling this turn
Pedestrian crowd: swerve or ram
Shortcut: one pursuer falls back
Construction site: high cover for one turn
Ambush: a new pursuer appears (close)
Chase.fewLegs: The deck has only {n} leg cards for {legs} legs.
Chase.dropVehicle: Drop the players' vehicle here, or select its token.
Chase.endTurn: End turn: flip the primary path
Chase.enemiesHint: Drop actors here, or add the selected / targeted tokens. Engaged and close pursuers can attack and be attacked.
Chase.flyingHint: Flying: cannot be escaped, always close (p.152).
Chase.selectToken: Select or target a token first.
Chase.emptyPath: That path has no cards left.
Chase.switched: The route switches: path {path} is now primary.
Chase.burned: The top card of path {path} is discarded.
Chase.plotted: A card on path {path} is revealed.

outcome.legs: All legs completed: the players reach safe territory and escape!
outcome.evaded: No pursuers left: the players escape!
outcome.wrecked: The players' vehicle is wrecked: final shootout! Mark an escape zone behind the opponents.

actionHint.trap: 4 successes: a non-primary path card hits the pursuers. A failure hits you instead.
actionHint.book: 2 successes: trigger the primary path card now.
actionHint.burn: 4 successes: discard the top card of the primary path.
actionHint.plot: 1 success (scouting drone): reveal a path card.

attack.derez: De-rez (1d6 per net success to cohesion)

line.weapon: Digital attack: damage {damage}, reduced by hardening (ignores {ignore})
line.derez: De-rez: each success left after defense and hardening deals 1d6 to cohesion
line.acid: Acid Burn: lowers the target's hardening by net successes + {rating}÷2
line.strike: Electric Strike: {damage} (1d6) + successes stun · no dodge, ignores armor · ×2 vs machines and software

Digital.title: Digital attack: {name}
Digital.defenseHint: Dodge or defense dice of the target (defensive daemons add their dice).
Digital.acidApplied: Acid Burn: {name}'s hardening drops from {from} to {to}.
Digital.crashed: {name}'s cohesion track is full: the software crashes and must reboot (about 5 minutes).
Digital.entityHint: ICE / daemon: only the cohesion track (the stun track) takes damage; hardening reduces every attack; defense dice double against physical and magic attacks (pp.133, 205).
Digital.shrinkLine: The decker's influence field shrinks by {n} m.
Digital.shrinkNoTarget: Target a decker to shrink their influence.
Digital.shrunk: {name}'s influence shrinks by {loss} m to {n} m.
Digital.shrunkOut: {name}'s influence collapses (−{loss} m): control of the node is lost. Feedback is up to the Agonarch.
Digital.noPermission: You do not own that actor.
